description:
Position Overview 
 This position is responsible for implementing software to meet functional requirements and to build efficient, highly scalable solutions for Asset Management project team.  The person in this role must have experience in object oriented design and development with advanced Java technologies and have a desire to work in a highly collaborative team, using agile development methodologies. 

 Core Skills/Responsibilities: 
 Strong programming experience in core Java, Python (someone who has built many tools/written many apps)
 Systems related experience (building monitoring tools, comfortable with Unix/Linux, etc.)
 Cloud (AWS) and Docker experience 
 Experience creating CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Bamboo, etc).
 Experience building/maintaining enterprise level infrastructure
 Been part of the release process
 HA Proxy
 Start-up experience preferred  - Good problem solvers - comfortable wearing multiple hats (everyone on the team is involved in the architecture, design, development, etc.)
 
 Other Skills: 
 Knowledge of non-relational databases such as MongoDB, Amazon S3, Cassandra highly desirable
 Experience working with accelerated file transfer systems such as Aspera and Signiant highly desirable.
 Experience with Digital Asset Management systems highly desirable
 Implement new functionality in the UI and backend, including database access, integration through backend Web Services, etc.
 Perform performance tuning, improvement, balancing, automation
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
